preconditions.description: The input is an integer n representing the number of nodes in the tree, where 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output consists of either two trees (each with n-1 edges) or one '-1' and one tree (if a tree doesn't exist for one section).

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(u) <= int(stdin.strip()) and 1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.strip()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line != '-1' for u, v in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Each edge in the output is represented by two integers u and v, where 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n.
The input n is within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: any(line == '-1' for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()) or (len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == 2 * (int(stdin.strip()) - 1))
postconditions.description: If a tree doesn't exist for a section, output '-1' for that section only; otherwise, output exactly two trees (each with n-1 edges).

postconditions.expression: all(is_tree(n, edges) for n, edges in [(int(stdin.strip()), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line != '-1'][0:int(stdin.strip())-1]), (int(stdin.strip()), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line != '-1'][int(stdin.strip())-1:2*(int(stdin.strip())-1)])] if len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == 2 * (int(stdin.strip()) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each section of the output must represent a valid tree (connected, acyclic, and undirected) with n nodes.

postconditions.expression: any(incorrect_algorithm(n, edges) for n, edges in [(int(stdin.strip()), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line != '-1'][0:int(stdin.strip())-1])] if len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == 2 * (int(stdin.strip()) - 1))
postconditions.description: The first tree (if it exists) must be such that Mahmoud's algorithm produces an incorrect answer.

postconditions.expression: any(correct_algorithm(n, edges) for n, edges in [(int(stdin.strip()), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() if line != '-1'][int(stdin.strip())-1:2*(int(stdin.strip())-1)])] if len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == 2 * (int(stdin.strip()) - 1))
postconditions.description: The second tree (if it exists) must be such that Mahmoud's algorithm produces a correct answer.
